headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express Timetable Released
summary: A official timetable has been announced for the new Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Goa. The service aims to improve rail transit across the region.

headline: New Vande Bharat Offers Scenic 13-Hour Route to Goa
summary: A new Vande Bharat train will connect Bengaluru to Goa in approximately 13 hours. Passengers on board will get scenic views of the Western Ghats during the trip.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Launched as Older Route Discontinued
summary: The 13-hour Vande Bharat train service between Bengaluru and Goa via Mangaluru is launching soon. Consequently, the Madgaon-Mangaluru train service has been discontinued.

headline: Goa Police Officer Accused of Assaulting Minor at Crime Branch
summary: A police officer in Goa faces allegations of repeatedly assaulting a minor girl inside the Crime Branch office. An official investigation into the incident has been initiated.

headline: FIR Filed Against Crime Branch Inspector and Woman in Minor Assault Case
summary: Authorities have registered an FIR against a Crime Branch police inspector and an accompanying woman regarding a minor assault case. Legal proceedings are currently under way.

headline: Police Inspector Booked for Assaulting Teen Who Filed Cyber Complaint
summary: A Goa police inspector reportedly summoned a teenage girl to the police station regarding a cyber complaint and sexually assaulted her. The incident has drawn severe outrage and legal action.

headline: K Annamalai Completes Ironman 70.3 Challenge in Goa
summary: BJP leader K Annamalai successfully completed the Ironman 70.3 triathlon held in Goa. Following the race, he shared details about his grueling experience during the endurance event.

headline: FC Goa Edges Past Inter Kashi to Claim First Win
summary: FC Goa secured their first victory of the season by defeating Inter Kashi in a closely contested match. The win gives the team a needed boost in the standings.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Route to Take 13 Hours via Western Ghats
summary: The upcoming Vande Bharat Express will shorten journey times between Bengaluru and Goa to 13 hours. The scenic route passes through the Western Ghats mountain range.

headline: Goa Dairy Maintains Milk Prices Despite Karnataka Hike
summary: Goa Dairy has decided to hold milk prices steady for local consumers. The decision comes even after neighboring Karnataka approved a price increase for its dairy products.

headline: Questions Raised Over Voter Name Deletions in Goa
summary: Discussions have arisen in Goa regarding the number of voter deletions across Hindu, Christian, and Muslim communities. Stakeholders are evaluating recent updates to the electoral rolls.

headline: Investigation Cites Crew Error in Goa Airport Runway Incursion
summary: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau cited pilot error and miscommunication for a runway incursion involving an Air India Express flight in Goa. Safety protocols are under review.

headline: New Vande Bharat Route Announced Between Bengaluru and Goa
summary: A new Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru and Goa will travel through picturesque areas of the Western Ghats. Route details have been published for prospective passengers.

headline: Goa GST Collections Rise 37 Percent, Beating National Average
summary: Goa registered a 37 percent increase in GST revenue collections, outperforming the national average growth rate. The surge reflects increased economic activity within the state.

headline: Bengaluru Couple Relocates to Goa for Rs 75,500
summary: A couple moved from Bengaluru to Goa and shared that their relocation cost totalled Rs 75,500. They stated the move was completely worth the expenditure and effort.

headline: Police Inspector Booked for Assaulting Minor at Crime Branch
summary: A police inspector in Goa has been charged after allegedly assaulting a minor girl multiple times inside the Crime Branch office. Official complaints have triggered an active investigation.

headline: FC Goa Defeats Inter Kashi 2-1 for First ISL Win
summary: Goals from Franchu and Chiki propelled FC Goa to a victory against Inter Kashi. The win marks FC Goa's first victory of their current ISL campaign.

headline: Army Athlete Biten Singh Sets Course Record at Ironman 70.3 Goa
summary: Indian Army athlete Biten Singh won the Ironman 70.3 race in Goa while establishing a new course record. His performance highlighted the national endurance event.

headline: Goa Delegation to Meet Solicitor General Over ST Reservation
summary: A delegation from Goa is scheduled to meet the Solicitor General to discuss Scheduled Tribe reservation issues. The meeting aims to address ongoing community demands.

headline: Goa Dairy Holds Milk Rates Steady as Nandini Raises Prices
summary: Goa Dairy has maintained its milk retail prices despite regional supplier Nandini increasing rates by Rs 8 per liter. Local consumers will see unchanged prices at retail points.

headline: Goan Gin Brand Vanaha Launches and Seeks Retail Expansion
summary: Goa-based gin brand Vanaha has officially launched its product line and is pursuing expansion into travel retail channels. The brand aims to increase its footprint in key retail outlets.

headline: FC Goa Secures Initial Campaign Victory Against Inter Kashi
summary: FC Goa earned their first win of the ISL season with a solid performance against Inter Kashi. The team claimed three key points in the overall standings.

headline: Old Goa PRASHAD Project Delayed by Heritage Regulations
summary: Development under the PRASHAD scheme in Old Goa has run into delays related to heritage and historical site clearances. Authorities are addressing conservation compliance requirements.

headline: Goa and Bihar Cricket Teams Seek First Win After Setbacks
summary: Both Goa and Bihar cricket teams are searching for their first win after suffering three consecutive losses in domestic matches. Both squads hope to reverse their recent losing streak.

headline: Goa Connects Folk Artistes and Students to Event Industry
summary: A new state initiative links traditional folk artistes, self-help groups, and students directly with the event management industry. The program aims to create new economic opportunities.

headline: Goa Simplifies Marriage Registration for Destination Weddings
summary: Goa is implementing faster marriage registration procedures tailored for couples holding destination weddings in the state. The move is designed to boost wedding-related tourism.

headline: Oktoberfest and Ironman Events Cause Traffic Delays in Panaji
summary: Traffic came to a standstill across Panaji due to simultaneous Oktoberfest celebrations and the Ironman triathlon event. Authorities advised motorists to expect delays and use alternate routes.

headline: Goa Airports Add 84 Flights to Boost Air Connectivity
summary: Goa's two operational airports have added 84 flights to their schedules to improve regional and national connectivity. The additional flights are expected to facilitate tourism growth.

headline: Goa Supplies 7.6 Lakh Tonnes of Waste to Cement Plants
summary: Goa has sent 7.6 lakh tonnes of waste to cement factories to be used as an alternative fuel source. The project forms part of the state's sustainable waste management efforts.

headline: Biten Singh Overcomes Past Setbacks to Win Ironman 70.3 Goa
summary: Indian Army athlete Biten Singh claimed victory at Ironman 70.3 Goa, overcoming previous race setbacks. He set a record time during his winning performance.

headline: Fire Destroys Over 150 Shops at Vasco Market in Goa
summary: A massive fire broke out at Vasco Market in Goa, destroying more than 150 commercial shops. Firefighters managed to extinguish the blaze, and damage assessments are underway.

headline: Kerala High Court Judge Completes Ironman 70.3 in Goa
summary: Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas of the Kerala High Court successfully finished the Ironman 70.3 triathlon in Goa. He competed alongside hundreds of participants in the endurance race.

headline: Quepem Artisan Preserves Traditional Goan Diwali Lanterns
summary: A local craftsman in Quepem continues to handcraft traditional Goan lanterns for Diwali celebrations. His effort helps preserve local heritage and festive customs.

headline: Multi-Crore Scam Uncovered Operating from Luxury Goa Villa
summary: Police uncovered a multi-crore financial fraud scheme operated by twelve individuals from a luxury villa in Goa. The suspects were taken into custody and their equipment was seized.

headline: Dempo SC Secures Late Winner Against Bengaluru United
summary: Dempo SC scored a late goal to earn a victory over Bengaluru United in a competitive fixture. The win secures three important points for the team.

headline: K Annamalai Overcomes Cramps to Finish Second Ironman 70.3
summary: BJP leader K Annamalai completed his second Ironman 70.3 race in Goa despite dealing with severe muscle cramps during the course. He expressed satisfaction at crossing the finish line.

headline: Chiki Goal Leads FC Goa to 2-1 Victory Over Inter Kashi
summary: A decisive goal by Chiki earned FC Goa a 2-1 win over Inter Kashi in their ISL fixture. FC Goa maintained control to seal the victory.

headline: Vibrant Goa Panels Call for Urgent Data Protection Measures
summary: Panels at the Vibrant Goa 2026 event highlighted the urgent need for robust data protection frameworks and secure AI adoption. Experts urged businesses to prepare for digital compliance.

headline: Cipla Reports Q2 Decline and Provides Update on Verna Plant Inspection
summary: Cipla Ltd reported a drop in revenue and profit for the second quarter alongside updates on an FDA inspection at its Verna facility in Goa. Investors are monitoring the company's regulatory status.

headline: Goa Congress Leaders Join INDIA Bloc Protest in Delhi
summary: Congress leaders from Goa participated in a major rally organized by the INDIA bloc in New Delhi. The demonstration focused on opposing specific government policies.

headline: President's Award-Winning Police Inspector Booked Under POCSO Act
summary: A Goa police inspector who previously received the President's Colour has been booked under the POCSO Act for minor assault. An investigation into the matter is ongoing.

headline: Kejriwal Expresses Confidence in AAP forming Goa Government
summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal stated that voters in Goa want an alternative to the BJP and Congress. He expressed optimism about AAP's chances in upcoming state elections.

headline: FC Goa Defeats Inter Kashi FC in ISL Encounter
summary: FC Goa secured a victory over Inter Kashi FC thanks to timely goals during their ISL match. The result strengthens FC Goa's position in the tournament.

headline: Goa Announces Revised Land Rates for 2026-27
summary: The Goa government set new official land rates for 2026-27, pricing prime areas in Panaji and coastal Bardez at Rs 25,000 per square meter. The updates aim to standardize property valuations.

headline: SGPDA Market Revival Commitments Unfulfilled in South Goa
summary: Promises made by the South Goa Planning and Development Authority regarding market renovations remain pending. Local vendors expressed disappointment over the ongoing delays.

headline: Traffic Restrictions Announced for Goa Ironman Event
summary: Road closures and traffic diversions were announced across Goa on November 1 to accommodate the Ironman triathlon. Drivers were asked to follow designated alternate routes.

headline: Vande Bharat Express to Connect Bengaluru with Goa and Mumbai
summary: Indian Railways is expanding Vande Bharat Express connectivity, adding direct routes linking Bengaluru with both Goa and Mumbai. The trains aim to reduce intercity travel times.

headline: Bengaluru Couple Details Rs 75,500 Cost of Moving to Goa
summary: A couple who relocated from Bengaluru to Goa outlined their total moving expenses of Rs 75,500. They described the move as a highly rewarding experience.

headline: Biten Singh Wins Ironman Goa with Record Time
summary: Biten Singh finished in first place at the Ironman 70.3 event in Goa, setting a new course record. His speed and endurance secured his historic win.

headline: Inter Kashi Focuses on Defense Ahead of FC Goa Clash
summary: Inter Kashi aimed to reform their defense ahead of their ISL match against FC Goa in Pune. The team focused on tactical adjustments to improve their defensive structure.
